artlyrics.screen.title: Artlyrics
artlyrics.option.player.tooltip: When more than one app is playing, Artlyrics follows the one whose name contains this.
artlyrics.option.demo.tooltip: Loops a short built-in song so you can try out palettes and animations without any music. Close this screen to watch it.
artlyrics.mode.skywriting.tooltip: Each line is written across the sky where you were looking and slowly drifts upward. Hills and trees can get in the way.
artlyrics.mode.hover.tooltip: Lines hang just above your crosshair and trail behind as you turn. Nothing can cover them.
artlyrics.animation.bloom.tooltip: Each word opens up bright and settles into the palette as it's sung.
artlyrics.animation.typewriter.tooltip: Words are typed out letter by letter in time with the singing.
artlyrics.animation.sweep.tooltip: The whole line appears faintly and color sweeps along it with the singing.
artlyrics.animation.spotlight.tooltip: Just the word being sung, large and centered.
artlyrics.status.nothing_playing: Start a song in Spotify or any music player
artlyrics.status.unsynced_only: No timed lyrics for this song
